class.name: NNAngleVector2Sensor
class.brief_description: Measures the signed 2D angle between two vectors and maps it to [code]0..1[/code].
class.description: Computes the signed angle from [member from_vector] to [member to_vector] and normalizes it across [member min_angle_degrees]..[member max_angle_degrees] into a [code]0..1[/code] sensor value. Useful for checking whether a 2D target lies to the left, right, or in front of an entity's facing direction.

members.member: Computed signed angle in degrees, clamped to the configured min/max range.
Computed signed angle in radians, clamped to the configured min/max range.
Reference direction vector (for example, the entity's facing direction).
Maximum signed angle in degrees, mapping to [code]1.0[/code]. Syncs with [member max_angle_radian].
Maximum signed angle in radians, mapping to [code]1.0[/code]. Syncs with [member max_angle_degrees].
Minimum signed angle in degrees, mapping to [code]0.0[/code]. Syncs with [member min_angle_radian].
Minimum signed angle in radians, mapping to [code]0.0[/code]. Syncs with [member min_angle_degrees].
Target direction vector compared against [member from_vector] (for example, the direction toward an enemy).
